newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chun Wo venture pays HK$729 mln premium.
newsitem.headline: Chun Wo venture pays HK$729 mln premium.

text.p: Construction firm Chun Wo Holdings Ltd said on Friday its 40 percent owned Grand View Properties Ltd had paid HK$729 million for the balance of a land premium in Hammer Hill Road in Kowloon.

Chun Wo said it had provided a guarantee to a lender, which is a unit of China Merchants Holdings (Hong Kong) Co Ltd, in respect of the company's HK$291.6 million contribution in proportion to its shareholding in Grand View.
China Merchants Holdings owns 60 percent of Grand View, the statement said.

Grand View had submitted a tender for the granting of a land site in Hammer Hill Road in Kowloon for a project under the government's home ownership scheme at a premium of HK$810 million. The tender had been accepted by the government.
Chun Wo said Grand View had paid HK$81 million, or 10 percent of the premium, in March and the payment was funded by internal resources of the joint venture partners.
